_rules_note: Ordered and first-wins, substring-matched against the filename. Written as explicit product names rather than short keywords: with only 19 files a clever pattern buys nothing and 'ai' alone is one new filename away from swallowing something it should not. 'general' is last and therefore the fallback; it is currently empty, and the chip bar hides empty buckets.
_synonyms_note: Bidirectional search aliases: any term in a group finds any other. Product marks are the case where this matters most, because the short form is what people actually type.
